svg.title: Triangle configuration with 20 points
svg.desc: Triangle configuration with 20 points. Only 35 triangles lie within relative 1/1000000000 of the exact normalised minimum 0.0126093915286413226018464017702; all other triangles are omitted. Exact minima use the orange, heavier style and near-minima use the blue, lighter style. Hover a triangle to isolate it, click to keep it selected, shift-click to filter its congruence class, or select a point to show only limiting triangles containing that point.
